title: TONSTAD door with hinges
description: TONSTAD door with hinges, off-white, 191/2x765/8" Use this door in graceful off-white to match your PAX wardrobe with TONSTAD chest of drawers, bed frame and bedside table. A great way to create a high-quality uniform style throughout the bedroom! The door can be hung to open either right or left.
features: Hinges are included in the combination but come in a separate package.
This door can only be used with the 79⅛" high PAX frame.
materialAndCare: Fiberboard and honeycomb paper filling (100% recycled paper), Acrylic paint; Main parts: Steel, Nickel plated; Plastic parts: Acetal plastic
